items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: old left-handed Ike Rod Dixon was seen in the alley with fancy doing the fanning, things like that.

ctx.x: Who are just kind of hanging out.

That's where you get a lot of conversation. Right. And you learn a lot of things about the neighborhood. Yeah, oh, yeah. And what went on and so forth and so on. We're talking about gossip. Oh, yeah. And incidentally, I never forget, they had a fellow by the name of Freddie Craft over in Gretchen. He used to... He was the circulation representative for the Brotherhood Eyes. Some of the greatest journalistic writing I have ever seen in my life was in the Brotherhood Eyes. But there was slam-bass people about…
But this was all barbershop gossip or street copy?
